retain root/session through caller debt, reader
drain and GC epoch retirement
execution-owner
Alternative A retains session and scanned roots,
suppresses cancellation before entering the no-
GC/no-callback decrement-to-record interval

GC request is not collector entry permission;

VM retirement excludes unknown guard custody,
exported handles, current invocations and inherited
processor/storage debt

Alternative B uses one stable atomic Active-to-
Released token as native authority and marker
validity; scalar count becomes nonauthoritative or
is removed for this ownership class

Stable VM guardian retains roots and session on
unlogged legacy outcome; no timeout transfer or
blind retry; confirmed death still needs root/roster
handoff

Pending log alone cannot distinguish decrement-
before-abandonment from abandonment-before-

release-query
After lost reply acquire exact generation token;
helper may reconstruct release receipt but cannot
declare caller restoration or live catcher complete
